0.reason: the distributed case's relative assertion is superseded by read-cost §9, whose test asserts the absolute zero on the distributed path

findings.summary: the distributed case asserts the plan read composes no more than the inventory reader rather than the done-when's absolute zero, so a change making both paths compose once more leaves it green and the plan's stated measure unasserted for distributed stores.

_project_state_lists composes the whole project state on every distributed summary read, so read_plan(view="summary") of one plan still composes once; it predates the change, sits outside the node's fence and is disclosed under outside_scope, and reaching the plan's zero needs its own node.
baseline_suite.command names two test files while its log_path importers-base.log records a four-file command, so the arm's recorded command is not the string the log actually ran.
